

The key difference between the two states is that the robot has successfully grasped and lifted the red cube. In the previous state, the red cube was resting on the table surface with the gripper positioned above it in an open state. In the current state, the gripper has descended to the cube, closed around it, and lifted it off the table. The cube is now held between the gripper fingers, suspended above the table surface. The task of picking up and lifting the red cube has been completed.
